scoring_justification: The agent produces the final computed numbers from a complex computational pipeline (LAMMPS relaxation + tight-binding); recomputing from raw atomic coordinates and Hamiltonian is not feasible in the verifier sandbox. Result-level comparison with generous tolerances is the appropriate fallback.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden reference values for charge density and surface potential
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from the paper: charge density modulation approx. ±3 mC/m² (Fig. 3e) and surface potential modulation approx. 0.2 eV (text and Fig. 3f).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper description and set to 3.0 mC/m² and 0.2 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numbers reported by the paper for the specified stronger-hopping scenario.

outputs.description: Computed surface charge density modulation in mC/m².
Estimated surface potential modulation in eV.
